title: Explicit Double raster arrays, guarded matrix centering and bounded immutable lineage facts

entry_inventory.interpretation: Name declarations only, not full API/signature, Google or project migration compatibility.

implementation.casts: Single fixed-shape array per-cell toDouble retains shape/order/name/input whole-array mask and metadata. Nested toFloat actually rounds; multiple array-band bundles still require explicit selection.
implementation.matrix_solve: Each input array needs uniform explicit toFloat/toDouble cells, with either Double input promoting the solve. Constant literal full-column-rank design only; m1..8,n1..4,k1..4,m>=n,combined cells<=64. Finite cast chains and <=500 distinct literal nodes are validated before NumPy allocation; cycles/malformed values/rank deficiency reject. lstsq(A,I,rcond=None) generates bounded finite pseudoinverse, then actual raster scalar expressions. NumPy policy is not a Google/EJML rank oracle; Float32 path unchanged.
implementation.centering: A proven nonzero constant predictor column enables Double per-RHS first-observation centering and restoration of that predictor coefficient. A conservative magnitude guard uses scaled max(abs(response)) before enabling anchors; extreme opposite-sign values fall back to the existing P*y expression to avoid new subtraction overflow. All new scans/guards/copies/expressions are precharged. No-constant designs retain the original path. Fallback and general designs can still exhibit binary64 cancellation.
implementation.properties: Explicit staged dtype for trace, determinant, scaled Frobenius norm, diagonal construction and prefix SUM/MIN/MAX. Double diagonal zeros share source-bound abs(input0)*0 and have canonical positive-zero bits. Rank/shape/name/metadata and input-mask semantics remain; determinant is a bounded permutation polynomial, not stable LU.
implementation.lineage_cache: One translator owns at most4096 strong exact-identity entries with charged lookups/insertion/eviction. Only immutable expression structure and Source cid/ids lineage facts are reused; mutable Pixel args, lists/dicts/unknown descendants prevent ancestor caching. Active-cycle rejection precedes reuse. Numeric values, catalog/projection metadata and query grids are not cached by this mechanism.

limits.policy: No cap increases. Direct maximum-dimension IR construction fits, while a full8x4-by8x4 sixteen-output public raster graph still rejects at the work limit. IR node counts are not canonical process-node/runtime acceptance.

implementation.nonfinite_policy: Native Double input +/-Infinity rejects, including Infinity created by a prior Float32 conversion. NaN inputs remain masks; finite-input operation overflow/domain errors become NaN NoData. The independent sample interpreter was corrected to this already-existing native contract; no engine behavior changed.

warnings.scope: No dependency/interpreter changes and no new vulnerability scan. Intentional Float32 overflow warnings are captured in the specific rejection controls.
